The '''Mote''' was a cobbled-together [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] in the [[Kuna's Eye system/Legends|Kuna's Eye system]] of the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell subsector]], situated inside the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]] and within the [[Inner Zuma Region]]. It fulfilled the needs of the [[Prospector/Legends|prospectors]] who frequented the [[Star system/Legends|system]], having a Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and providing standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. Inhabited by 1,000 individuals of various [[Species/Legends|species]], the station contained several facilities, including a standard [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. It was the site of multiple [[Lightfight|gun battles]] throughout its history.

==Description==
The [[Space station/Legends|space station]]<ref name="gamer9" /> known as the Mote was located near the edge of the [[Kuna's Eye system/Legends|Kuna's Eye system]],<ref name="TEA" /> inside the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector's]] [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell subsector]]<ref name="teaoc" /> and the [[Inner Zuma Region]]. Since its parent [[Star system/Legends|system]] was less than 1,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] above the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic plane]], it was also part of the thick disk, a region that spanned the same vertical distance in both directions from the plane.<ref name="TEA" />

The cobbled-together Mote had standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and a Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. It contained [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], [[flophouse]]s, [[Lawyer/Legends|law]] offices, mini-refineries, and a standard [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]],<ref name="gamer9" /> and served the [[Prospector/Legends|prospectors]] frequenting the system.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
By [[43 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Mote supported a population of 1,000 individuals of different [[Species/Legends|species]] and had experienced several [[Lightfight|gun battles]]. Multiple deals had also been brokered aboard it.<ref name="gamer9" /> It had also become a lawless spaceport, known as a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mote was first mentioned in the ''[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]'' article&mdash;authored by [[Craig Robert Carey]], [[Daniel Wallace]], and [[Jason Fry]]&mdash;of the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine, released on [[March 1]], [[2002]].<ref name="gamer9" /> It was also referenced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="TEA" /> a reference book written by Wallace and Fry, and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]].<ref name="teaoc" />
